notes.title: FIX 1.1.4
notes.content:
Fixed:

1. In the 'Choose Room' section, after clicking on the button labeled 'Room A,' the content displayed corresponds to Room B instead. Similarly, after clicking on the button labeled 'Room B,' the content displayed corresponds to Room A.

2. In the level containing the monster, some walls and even numbers disappeared after the player's death.

notes.title: FIX 1.1.3
notes.content:
Fixed:

1. If the player entered the cave and then returned outside to the cabin, the cave map disappeared.

Added:

1. More Info to the controls guide

notes.title: Fix 1.1.2
notes.content:
Fixed 

1.When the player returned to the cellar after loading the outdoor map, the map disappeared.
2.The hanged man's whisper could be triggered multiple times, leading to the overlap of several sounds at once.

notes.title: Fix 1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed

1. After the previous update, the map that comes after the elevator stopped loading. We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and the issue has been fixed with this update.

notes.title: Fix 1.1.0
notes.content:
Fixed

1. The green code could be revealed through the wall.

notes.title: Fix 1.0.8
notes.content:
Based on reviews and information from discussions, we have fixed the following issues:

1. Papers from black stain could be picked up early, causing incorrect paper display.
2. The map outside the cabin may not have loaded in time for some players.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new checkpoints to total 5 checkpoints that can be loaded .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827391/016d1fd02dbf548f7f11ab582dd515b0ce879616.png[/img]
[*] Adjusted volume level of some sounds near the ending.
[*] Added limitations to the Vault app so you can view only rooms that you have access to.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827391/7b8805a53c81e13751c4ed74cc10cd7f9ca48a10.png[/img]
[*] Fixed collision problem in the warehouse. Player could not reach one side of the room.
[*] Adjusted hatch door collision so player can reach it without crouching. 
[*] Adjusted slider lock on one of the doors in the freezer room that was easily overlooked.
[*] Adjusted one scare moment that was easily overlooked.
[*] Removed wrong text in the READ function.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.5 - Minor fix/update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Based on testing, I found that some items can be easily overlooked. Therefore, the position or size of certain items has been modified. 

[*] Additional hints have been added to the 'Vault' application.

[*] Added hint with the number of characters needed to unlock the green photo in the computer.

[/list]
